title: Concept: Crate declares an old minimum Rust version
description: Cargo.toml declares a `rust-version` below the supported toolchain floor, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `rust-version` below the supported toolchain floor.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `rust-version` below the supported toolchain floor.
